passage:

B: Hi, I'd like to book a grooming appointment for my dog.
A: Sure, what breed is he, and how big?
B: He's a golden retriever, quite large, about thirty kilos.
A: Okay, for a large dog, a full groom is forty-five pounds — actually, sorry, golden retrievers need extra de-shedding treatment, so it's fifty-five pounds for the full package.
B: That's fine. When can you fit him in?
A: We have Monday at ten a.m. or Wednesday at one p.m.
B: Wednesday at one is better for us.
A: Great. Does he have any skin conditions or allergies?
B: Yes, he's allergic to a certain shampoo brand, so please avoid anything with lavender.
A: Noted, I'll tell the groomer. Can I get your name?
B: It's Marianne Kirkpatrick — K-I-R-K-P-A-T-R-I-C-K.
A: And your number?
B: 0769 254 8871.
A: Thanks, Marianne. Please bring his vaccination record, and note that owners aren't allowed to stay in the grooming area during the session.

passage: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the City History Museum. My name is Claudia, and I'll be guiding you through today. We'll begin on the ground floor, which houses artefacts from the medieval period, including coins, tools, and pottery found during the construction of the new bridge in 2019. From there, we'll move up to the first floor, where the Victorian gallery is located — please note that photography is allowed there, but flash photography is not, as it can damage the fabric exhibits. The second floor was originally going to be our final stop, but due to a new temporary exhibition on ancient trade routes, we'll actually be ending the tour on the third floor instead, which offers a wonderful view of the old town. The whole tour will take about ninety minutes. Please stay with the group at all times, and if you need to step away, let me know first. There is a gift shop on the ground floor, and it stays open thirty minutes after the museum closes for visitors who want to make a purchase. Restrooms are located near the entrance and on the second floor. Let's get started — please follow me to the first exhibit.
stem: What is the main purpose of this talk?
options: To introduce a guided museum tour
explain_zh: 這段獨白是導覽員在博物館入口為遊客介紹整個導覽行程的安排，屬於典型的導覽開場白。其餘選項如賣票、招募志工都沒有出現在內容中。

passage: Hi everyone, thanks for coming. I'm Marcus from the town council, and I want to give you a quick update on the upcoming Riverside Autumn Festival. The festival was originally planned for the second Saturday of October, but due to a scheduling clash with the regional marathon, it has been moved to the third Saturday instead. The event will run from ten in the morning until eight in the evening, and it will take place in Riverside Park, near the old boathouse. This year we're introducing a new craft market with over thirty local stalls, alongside the usual food trucks and live music stage. Entry is free for everyone, but there will be a small charge of three pounds for the children's activity zone, which covers face painting and games. We're also looking for volunteers to help with setup on the Friday evening before the festival, and anyone who volunteers for at least two hours will get a free festival T-shirt. If you're interested, please sign up at the community centre desk by the end of this week. Parking near the park is limited, so we strongly recommend walking or cycling if possible.
stem: What is this announcement mainly about?

passage: Hi everyone, thanks for coming. I'm Marcus from the town council, and I want to give you a quick update on the upcoming Riverside Autumn Festival. The festival was originally planned for the second Saturday of October, but due to a scheduling clash with the regional marathon, it has been moved to the third Saturday instead. The event will run from ten in the morning until eight in the evening, and it will take place in Riverside Park, near the old boathouse. This year we're introducing a new craft market with over thirty local stalls, alongside the usual food trucks and live music stage. Entry is free for everyone, but there will be a small charge of three pounds for the children's activity zone, which covers face painting and games. We're also looking for volunteers to help with setup on the Friday evening before the festival, and anyone who volunteers for at least two hours will get a free festival T-shirt. If you're interested, please sign up at the community centre desk by the end of this week. Parking near the park is limited, so we strongly recommend walking or cycling if possible.

passage: Good afternoon, and welcome to Kingsley University. I'm Professor Adeyemi, and on behalf of the faculty, I'd like to walk you through a few important points before the semester begins. First, all new students must complete their course registration online by the thirty-first of this month — the original deadline was the twenty-fifth, but it's been extended by six days due to the recent system upgrade. Orientation week activities will be held across campus, and the main welcome event takes place in the Grand Hall at two p.m. on Monday. Please bring your student ID card, which you can collect from the administration office on the ground floor of the library building. Each student is also assigned an academic advisor, and you should arrange a first meeting within your first two weeks. For students living in the dormitories, check-in begins this Sunday at nine a.m., and rooms must be vacated during winter break unless you apply for special permission. Lastly, the student union offers over fifty clubs and societies, and joining one is a great way to make friends early on. If you have questions, the student services desk is open every weekday from nine to five.
stem: What is the main purpose of this talk?
options: To orient new students before the semester
explain_zh: 這段獨白是教授在為新生說明開學前的重要事項，屬於典型的新生說明會內容。其餘選項如公告考試成績、招募教職員都沒有出現。

passage: Welcome to Pinecrest National Park. Before you head out on the trails, I'd like to go over a few important rules. The park covers a large area, and the main visitor trail is six kilometres long, taking most walkers about two hours to complete. Please stay on the marked paths at all times — leaving the trail can damage the local plant life, which the park has been working to restore for over a decade. Campfires are strictly prohibited anywhere in the park due to wildfire risk, though we do provide designated barbecue areas near the entrance for cooking. We originally allowed dogs on all trails, but following some incidents with wildlife, dogs are now only permitted on the shorter riverside path, and they must be kept on a lead at all times. The visitor centre closes at five p.m., but the trails themselves remain open until sunset. If you plan to camp overnight, you'll need to book a permit in advance at the visitor centre, and only fifteen camping permits are issued per night to protect the environment. Lastly, please take all your rubbish with you, as there are no bins along the trails.
stem: What is this talk mainly about?
options: Rules for visiting the national park
explain_zh: 這段獨白是公園管理員在向遊客說明入園前必須遵守的規定，屬於典型的公園規則說明。其餘選項如小鎮方向、公園歷史都沒有出現。

passage: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by. I'm Leo, from the Coastal Care Society, and we're currently recruiting volunteers for our monthly beach cleanup programme. The cleanups take place on the first Sunday of every month at Seaford Beach, starting at eight in the morning and usually finishing by eleven. We originally met at the main car park, but since that area is being repaired, we now meet at the small car park near the lighthouse instead. All equipment, including gloves and rubbish bags, is provided, so you don't need to bring anything except comfortable shoes and, ideally, a reusable water bottle. Last month, our volunteers collected over two hundred kilograms of rubbish, mostly plastic bottles and fishing nets, which really shows how much this work matters. Volunteers under sixteen must be accompanied by an adult, and we ask everyone to sign a short registration form on the day for insurance purposes. After each cleanup, we usually have a short chat over coffee at the nearby cafe, which is a nice way to get to know other volunteers. If you'd like to join, just show up on the day, or email us in advance so we can keep a rough headcount.

To report on ocean pollution research

passage: Welcome to the Bluewater Aquarium, my name's Sian and I'll be your guide for today's tour. We'll start in the tropical zone, home to over sixty species of colourful reef fish, before moving on to the shark tunnel, where you can walk right underneath the tank. The shark feeding was originally scheduled for eleven o'clock, but since our marine biologist is running a special talk this morning, feeding has been moved to one p.m. instead. After the shark tunnel, we'll visit the touch pool, where children can gently handle starfish and small crabs under staff supervision. Please note that flash photography is not allowed anywhere in the aquarium, as it can stress the animals. The jellyfish exhibit, our newest addition, opened just last month and uses special lighting to highlight the jellyfish's natural glow. The full tour takes around seventy minutes, and there's a cafe near the exit if you'd like a break afterwards. Restrooms are located next to the gift shop. If anyone needs a wheelchair or pushchair, please ask a staff member at the front desk before we begin.
stem: What is the main purpose of this talk?
options: To introduce a guided aquarium tour
explain_zh: 這段獨白是導覽員在水族館入口介紹整個導覽行程，屬於典型的導覽開場白。其餘選項如會員推廣、鯊魚生態解說都不是主要目的。
